name: 11237 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11237 (Brooklyn) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11237 (Brooklyn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11237 (Brooklyn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
